title: Pointed-colimit comparison for an etale localization
statement: Let R be a commutative local ring with maximal ideal m, and let K be a separable closure of its residue field. Let c be a colimit cocone of the diagram of pointed etale R-algebra triples [lem-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-triples], with point C, structural map rho:R to C, and residue map psi:C to K satisfying rho=alpha_s followed by c_s and psi followed after c_s equal to the pointed residue map for every triple s. Fix a triple t=(S,q,phi), and let A=S_q, with its local-ring structure. Let chiA:kappa(A) to K be a residue embedding whose composite with S to A to kappa(A) equals S to kappa(q) to K. Let d be a colimit cocone of the pointed etale A-algebra triples for chiA, with point D, structural map delta:A to D, and residue map psiD:D to K satisfying the analogous cocone equations. There exists a unique ring equivalence e:D to C such that e composed with S to A to D equals the cocone map S to C, and psi composed with e equals psiD. No ideal or completion assertion is included.

source.place: Lemma Tag 06LJ (lemma-henselization-noetherian), proof part (c), paragraph beginning 'To finish the proof of (c)', using Algebra Tag 04GW (lemma-strict-henselization-different) and Tag 04GP (lemma-strict-henselization)

proof.text: Use the compatible-residue separable-closure lemma to put the specified algebra structure on K over the residue field of A. Apply strictHenselization_triples over both R and A. Transport the henselian local structures to the given cocones by the unique colimit isomorphisms. Colimit extensionality identifies the transported residue maps with psi and psiD, so they are surjective. Their kernels are the maximal ideals by the surjective field-map criterion.

For x outside the pointed prime of t, the stage residue of x in K is nonzero. The cocone compatibility and the kernel-maximal-ideal equality show its image in C is a unit. Extend the cocone map from t.B to C uniquely to betaC:A to C by IsLocalization.lift. Localization extensionality and hchiA identify its residue map.

Prove pointed_colimit_lift for an arbitrary prescribed residue embedding: use the single-etale ring lifting lemma at each triple, use its uniqueness to show the lifts form a cocone, and descend by IsColimit.desc. The identity triple gives base compatibility; colimit extensionality gives residue compatibility and uniqueness. Apply this over A to obtain f:D to C and over R to obtain g:C to D, with R to D given through t.B and A.

The single-etale uniqueness at t identifies g composed with the stage map from t.B to C with t.B to A to D. Localization extensionality implies g composed with betaC equals delta. Use pointed_colimit_lift uniqueness over R to show f composed with g is the identity of C, and over A to show g composed with f is the identity of D. Bundle these maps as a ring equivalence.

The base and residue compatibilities of f give the required two equations. For any other equivalence, localization extensionality identifies its restriction to A with betaC. Uniqueness in pointed_colimit_lift over A identifies its ring homomorphism with f, hence the equivalence is equal to the constructed one. No ideals or completions are transported.

proof_origin.place: Tags 04GW and 04GP for the pointed colimits; Tag 08HQ for the tensor-product single-etale lifting, followed by the cocone gluing argument of Tag 08HR. The given cocones are handled by colimit isomorphisms and the A compatibility by localization extensionality.

theorem strictHenselization_comparison
    (R : CommRingCat.{u}) [IsLocalRing R]
    (K : Type u) [Field K]
    [Algebra ((Spec R).residueField (IsLocalRing.closedPoint R)) K]
    [IsSepClosure ((Spec R).residueField (IsLocalRing.closedPoint R)) K]
    (c : Cocone (etaleResidueTriplesRingDiagram R (IsLocalRing.closedPoint R) K
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap
        ((Spec R).residueField (IsLocalRing.closedPoint R)) K))))
    (hc : IsColimit c)
    (ρ : R ⟶ c.pt) (ψ : c.pt →+* K)
    (hρ : ∀ s, s.α ≫ c.ι.app s = ρ)
    (hψ : ∀ s, ψ.comp (c.ι.app s).hom =
      ((ΓSpecIso s.B).inv ≫ (Spec s.B).Γevaluation s.q ≫ s.φ).hom)
    (t : EtaleResidueTriples R (IsLocalRing.closedPoint R) K
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap
        ((Spec R).residueField (IsLocalRing.closedPoint R)) K)))
    (A : CommRingCat.{u}) [Algebra t.B A] [IsLocalization.AtPrime A t.q.asIdeal]
    [IsLocalRing A]
    (χA : (Spec A).residueField (IsLocalRing.closedPoint A) ⟶ CommRingCat.of K)
    (hχA : CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap t.B A) ≫ (ΓSpecIso A).inv ≫
      (Spec A).Γevaluation (IsLocalRing.closedPoint A) ≫ χA =
      (ΓSpecIso t.B).inv ≫ (Spec t.B).Γevaluation t.q ≫ t.φ)
    (d : Cocone (etaleResidueTriplesRingDiagram A (IsLocalRing.closedPoint A) K χA))
    (hd : IsColimit d) (δ : A ⟶ d.pt) (ψD : d.pt →+* K)
    (hδ : ∀ s, s.α ≫ d.ι.app s = δ)
    (hψD : ∀ s, ψD.comp (d.ι.app s).hom =
      ((ΓSpecIso s.B).inv ≫ (Spec s.B).Γevaluation s.q ≫ s.φ).hom) :
    ∃! e : d.pt ≃+* c.pt,
      e.toRingHom.comp (δ.hom.comp (algebraMap t.B A)) = (c.ι.app t).hom ∧
      ψ.comp e.toRingHom = ψD
